name: Toolathlon (Tool Decathlon)
summary: Benchmark of 108 long-horizon agent tasks across 32 real applications and 604 tools (mostly MCP servers), each checked by a deterministic evaluation script.
description: Tasks start from realistic environment states (e.g. Canvas courses, real spreadsheets, Kubernetes clusters, WooCommerce shops) with deliberately fuzzy instructions, average about 20 tool-calling turns, and often span several apps. Each task runs in its own container. In the ICLR 2026 paper the best model, Claude 4.5 Sonnet, solved 38.6%. The repository is the Toolathlon-Verified final release (June 2026), with trajectories on Hugging Face, a free public evaluation service and a sandboxed branch. The repository has no license file.
